channels.name: REF_CLK
channels.purpose: Reference clock supplied by the host; seeds the device PLL. Frequency selected via bRefClkFreq (e.g. 19.2 / 26 / 38.4 / 52 MHz).
channels.idle_level: Free-running while the link is active.

channels.name: DOUT0_t/DOUT0_c
channels.purpose: M-PHY TX lane 0 differential pair (device transmit).
channels.idle_level: Parked in HIBERN8 / SLEEP between bursts.

channels.name: DIN0_t/DIN0_c
channels.purpose: M-PHY RX lane 0 differential pair (device receive).
channels.idle_level: Parked in HIBERN8 / SLEEP between bursts.

channels.name: DOUT1_t/DOUT1_c
channels.purpose: M-PHY TX lane 1 differential pair (optional second lane).

channels.name: DIN1_t/DIN1_c
channels.purpose: M-PHY RX lane 1 differential pair (optional second lane).

global_signals.name: REF_CLK
global_signals.purpose: Host-supplied reference clock for the device PLL.

handshake_pairs.name: NOP_OUT_IN
handshake_pairs.rule: Host sends NOP Out; device replies NOP In to confirm transport is up.

handshake_pairs.name: COMMAND_RESPONSE
handshake_pairs.rule: Host sends Command UPIU; device returns Data In/Out flow then a Response UPIU with status.

handshake_pairs.name: RTT_DATAOUT
handshake_pairs.rule: Device sends RTT UPIU granting write credit; host sends Data Out UPIUs up to the grant (bounded by bMaxNumOfRTT).

handshake_pairs.name: QUERY_REQ_RESP
handshake_pairs.rule: Host sends Query Request; device returns Query Response with the Descriptor/Attribute/Flag.

handshake_pairs.name: TASKMGMT_REQ_RESP
handshake_pairs.rule: Host sends Task Management Request; device returns Task Management Response.

dependency_graph.common_rule: Host supplies REF_CLK and controls RESET_n. After link startup and gear negotiation, the host initiates all transactions by submitting Command/Query/Task-Management/NOP-Out UPIUs; the device responds with Response/Data-In/RTT/Query-Response/Task-Management-Response/NOP-In/Reject UPIUs. Write data is gated by RTT.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Read payload (Data In) and write grants (RTT) depend on a prior Command UPIU. UniPro delivers UPIUs reliably and in order; M-PHY carries UniPro frames as 8b/10b symbols in HS bursts.

logical_signaling_levels.name: LP-00
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Bridge state before HS or Escape entry

ordering_rules.transport_ordering: UniPro v2.0 provides reliable in-order delivery within a CPort connection; UPIUs for a given task are delivered in order.
ordering_rules.command_ordering: SCSI Tagged Command Queuing allows the device to complete commands out of order across task tags; under MCQ, completions are posted per completion queue.

power_pins.name: VCCQ
power_pins.purpose: Low-voltage core / controller logic supply (~1.2 V class).

power_pins.name: VCCQ2
power_pins.purpose: Interface / I/O supply for the M-PHY and REF_CLK domain (~1.8 V class).
